$comment: Machine-readable defect manifest (ADR-0051). The startup banner reads this and names what is live at the running tag. Prose registry: apps/docs/mvp/defect-registry.md in the book repo.
summary: Ungated by construction. No permission check exists yet, so the headline authorization defects have nothing to live in.

defects.title: No gates of any kind
defects.detail: No tests, no CI, no analyzers, no architecture rules, no rails. Nothing in the repository is capable of catching a defect. This is the state chapters 1 through 4 describe, and it is deliberate.

defects.title: Stores policy, decides nothing
defects.detail: Users, roles with a parent role, grants, an audit log and a Blazor console exist. Nothing answers whether a subject may take an action on a resource. The permission check is the harvest task, built from this tag.

defects.title: Audit entries are freely mutable
defects.detail: AuditLogEntry exposes public setters on every property and nothing prevents an update or a delete. An append-only audit log is the rule chapter 2 turns into a gate; at this tag the rule exists only in prose.

defects.title: Role graph has no cycle detection or depth cap
defects.detail: A role may name a parent role with no check for a cycle and no bound on inheritance depth. Any future traversal of the role graph can loop forever.
